title: Identity Theft and Fraud Confirmation in Claimant Identity Verification
content:
A customer who reports that a claim on their profile was filed by someone else is referred to the fraud unit, and the claim is held for fraud review. Within Claimant Identity Verification, the fraud unit's confirmation is recorded by marking the verification case fraud confirmed.

## Policy statement

1. **Referral.** A customer who reports that a claim on their profile was filed by someone else is referred to the fraud unit, and the claim is held for fraud review.
2. **Condition for fraud confirmation.** A case is marked fraud confirmed only when an identity theft report document has been received and accepted on the case. The test is made against the documents recorded on that same case, before the case is marked.
3. **Report on the re-verification pathway.** On the Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification pathway the report must be a police report or an FTC IdentityTheft.gov report no older than the report age limit at receipt, together with the agency identity theft affidavit.
4. **Effect for the victim.** Once fraud is confirmed, benefits paid on the impostor claim are not an overpayment owed by the victim, and the victim's Form 1099-G for those payments is corrected under the tax statement rules of Unemployment Benefit Claims.
5. **Later genuine claims.** A genuine later claim by the victim is verified on the Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification pathway.

A case can be marked fraud confirmed from the opened or the in progress status; marking it places the linked claim on hold for fraud review.

## Condition table for marking a case fraud confirmed

| Identity theft report document received on the case | Report accepted on review | Case may be marked fraud confirmed |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |
| yes | no | no |
| no | — | no |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A victim later files a genuine claim of their own. That claim is verified on the Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification pathway, where the report must be a police report or an FTC IdentityTheft.gov report no older than the report age limit at receipt, together with the agency identity theft affidavit.
